item.title: Street lights not working, 20th October
item.description:
The street lights in this corner of the close have not worked for years. It is terrifying walking at night both being unable to see where you are going but also being pitch black, not able to witness where you are walking. Dangerous for the elderly or vulnerable people here! This has been reported to the council and housing association for years to no avail. It it both lights near 75 and 66 somerset close which do not work.
